reviews.reason: Jinshu 109 primary Chinese names 石季龍/季龍 as the Zhao ruler opposing Murong Huang (稱籓于石季龍; 季龍於是總眾而至; 石季龍自以安樂諸城守防嚴重; 後石季龍征遼; 石季龍克令支). The retained Jinshu 093 anchor likewise reads 及石季龍死 / 時石季龍新死. Chapter attribution and the existing native membership are supported by these witnesses. Bounded same-name overflow and proposal.unresolvedIdentity stay open; no new merge or separation.

sourceWitnesses.quote: 皝以段遼屢為邊患，遣將軍宋回稱籓于石季龍，請師討遼。
皝將圖石氏，從容謂諸將曰：「石季龍自以安樂諸城守防嚴重，城之南北必不設備，今若詭路出其不意，冀之北土盡可破也。」
邇者深副樂土之望，中國之人皆將壺餐奉迎，石季龍誰與居乎！
後石季龍征遼，皝親將三軍略令支以北，遼議欲追之，翰知皝躬自總戎，戰必克勝，乃謂遼曰：「今石氏向至，方對大故，不宜復以小小為事。
石季龍克令支，裕以郡降，拜北平太守，徵為尚書左丞。
及石季龍死，裒上表請伐之，即日戒嚴，直指泗口。

reviews.reason: Jinshu 109 names 東夷校尉封抽 abandoning Liaodong with other officers. The Jinshu 108 anchor attests the same 渤海封抽 and later 東夷校尉封抽 in the memorial to Tao Kan. Same personal name and office support the existing membership; proposal.unresolvedIdentity is preserved.

sourceWitnesses.quote: 襄平令王冰、將軍孫機以遼東叛於皝，東夷校尉封抽、護軍乙逸、遼東相韓矯、玄菟太守高詡等棄城奔還。
其後廆更寫前箋，並齎其東夷校尉封抽、行遼東相韓矯等三十餘人疏上侃府曰：

reviews.reason: Both Jinshu 109 targets read 張萌 on Murong Huang’s side in consecutive campaigns (將張萌逆擊 at Tuhe; 都尉張萌追擊，擒詠 at Wuxing). The Chinese supports the existing same-person membership; the 張濛 candidate is a different graph and is not adopted. proposal.unresolvedIdentity remains.

sourceWitnesses.quote: 段遼遂寇徒河，皝將張萌逆擊，敗之。
段遼遣將李詠夜襲武興，遇雨，引還，都尉張萌追擊，擒詠。

reviews.reason: Jinshu 109 first names 逸豆歸 as the Yuwen separate-division leader who expelled 乞得龜, then continues the Yuwen leadership narrative under 宇文歸 (raid on Anjin; host of Murong Han; Moqian Hun’s campaign; flight to 漠北; later destruction). No primary contradiction to the accepted membership treating 逸豆歸/宇文歸 as one chapter person; homonym candidates (including 宇文貴) stay unmerged. proposal.unresolvedIdentity remains.

sourceWitnesses.quote: 尋而宇文乞得龜為其別部逸豆歸所逐，奔死於外，皝率騎討之，逸豆歸懼而請和，遂築榆陰、安晉二城而還。
段蘭擁眾數萬屯於曲水亭，將攻柳城，宇文歸入寇安晉，為蘭聲援。
初，段遼之敗也，建威翰奔于宇文歸，自以威名夙振，終不保全，乃陽狂恣酒，被髮歌呼。
宇文歸遣其國相莫淺渾伐皝，諸將請戰，皝不許。
及遼奔走，翰又北投宇文歸。

supplementalEditorialRepairs.before: Murong coordinated a joint petition southward.
supplementalEditorialRepairs.after: Later Hui rewrote the earlier letter and, together with his Eastern Yi Colonel Feng Chou, acting Liaodong chancellor Han Jiao, and more than thirty others, submitted a memorial to Tao Kan’s headquarters, saying:
supplementalEditorialRepairs.sourceQuote: 其後廆更寫前箋，並齎其東夷校尉封抽、行遼東相韓矯等三十餘人疏上侃府曰：
supplementalEditorialRepairs.sourceBasedReason: The idiomatic English drops every named officer, the count of memorialists, and 侃府; the Chinese and the paired literal retain them. Host should check other chapters for the same collapsed English.

supplementalEditorialRepairs.before: Magistrate Wang Bing of Xiangping and general Sun Ji turned Liaodong against him, while Feng Chou, Yi Yi, Han Jiao, Gao Xu, and others abandoned their posts and fled.
supplementalEditorialRepairs.after: Xiangping magistrate Wang Bing and general Sun Ji rebelled in Liaodong against Huang; Eastern Yi Colonel Feng Chou, Protector Yi Yi, Liaodong chancellor Han Jiao, Xuantu prefect Gao Xu, and others abandoned their cities and fled back.
supplementalEditorialRepairs.sourceQuote: 襄平令王冰、將軍孫機以遼東叛於皝，東夷校尉封抽、護軍乙逸、遼東相韓矯、玄菟太守高詡等棄城奔還。
supplementalEditorialRepairs.sourceBasedReason: The idiomatic English omits the offices 東夷校尉/護軍/遼東相/玄菟太守 and softens 棄城奔還 to abandoned posts; titles identify 封抽 for this case. Paired literal already keeps the offices.

supplementalEditorialRepairs.before: Soon afterward Yuwen Qidegui was driven out by a rival kinsman, Yidougui, and died in exile; Huang led cavalry against Yidougui, who sued for peace; Huang then built Yuyin and Anjin and withdrew.
supplementalEditorialRepairs.after: Soon afterward Yuwen Qidegui was driven out by his separate-division leader Yidougui and died in exile; Huang led cavalry against Yidougui, who sued for peace; Huang then built Yuyin and Anjin and withdrew.
supplementalEditorialRepairs.sourceQuote: 尋而宇文乞得龜為其別部逸豆歸所逐，奔死於外，皝率騎討之，逸豆歸懼而請和，遂築榆陰、安晉二城而還。
supplementalEditorialRepairs.sourceBasedReason: 別部 is a separate division, not a ‘rival kinsman’; the paired literal already reads separate division.

supplementalEditorialRepairs.before: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you; with Shi Hu, who can compare!
supplementalEditorialRepairs.after: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you; Shi Jilong—who will dwell with him!
supplementalEditorialRepairs.sourceQuote: 邇者深副樂土之望，中國之人皆將壺餐奉迎，石季龍誰與居乎！
supplementalEditorialRepairs.sourceBasedReason: 誰與居乎 means who will dwell/remain with him, not ‘who can compare’. Paired idiomatic English already has the remain sense.
